title: F171.1 a photo or a PDF reaches a tool: the overview
caption: Four parts: the API takes a file as bytes, the session keeps it, the program's catalogue hands each pack the model it picks, and the tool has that model read the file into its record, with the cost in the ledger.

cards.title: F171.1 A photo or a PDF reaches a tool
cards.code: framework work, no bill in sight
cards.text: A pack's tool, given a model in its constructor, reads an uploaded photo or PDF into a record of the pack's own.

cards.title: The API takes bytes
cards.text: An attachment carries its bytes and its type beside the text it carries today.

cards.title: The session keeps it
cards.text: Kept in memory with the session, capped, and named to the model, never pasted into the prompt.

cards.title: The catalogue picks the model
cards.text: The host wraps each model once and hands them to the program's catalogue, which gives each pack one.

cards.title: The tool reads it
cards.text: Instructions and the file in, the filled record out, one call, its own row in the ledger.
